description: A post-production supervisor must lock the final delivery package for a limited-series episode headed to a regional streaming premiere, including the approved cut length, principal credit wording, caption format, audio-description file, and required delivery records.

shared_context.S1: The episode is currently assembled as a 55-minute picture with the draft title card and end credits.
shared_context.S2: The current delivery folder contains a stereo master, optional subtitle files, and a generic principal-credit block.
shared_context.S3: Mara has authority to lock the episode package before it is sent to the streaming distributor.
shared_context.S4: The production's normal final-lock procedure requires Mara to call on standards, business affairs, and accessibility one at a time; each department must read any applicable source-backed requirement aloud into the meeting record before Mara signs the delivery order.

PF1.text: Devon reviewed the distributor's regional standards memo this morning and confirmed that this episode must be delivered at exactly 52 minutes, with the three-minute reduction taken from the second act; the memo is still attached to Devon's review queue rather than the delivery folder.

PF2.text: Leah checked the executed lead-performer agreement and confirmed that the principal credit must be represented exactly as 'Starring | Featuring Lena Ortiz', with 'Featuring Lena Ortiz' immediately after the 'Starring' credit; the agreement was signed after the generic credit block was created and Leah has not yet updated the credit sheet.

PF3.text: Owen confirmed with the distributor's accessibility vendor that this title requires English SDH as a separate WebVTT file and audio description as a separate stereo WAV file; the vendor's confirmation arrived after the standard delivery checklist was circulated.

acceptance_conditions: The episode must be locked at exactly 52 minutes with the required second-act trim.
The principal credit must use exactly 'Starring | Featuring Lena Ortiz', placing 'Featuring Lena Ortiz' immediately after the 'Starring' credit.
English SDH must be delivered as a separate WebVTT file.
Audio description must be delivered as a separate stereo WAV file.
A standards-cut record, a contractual-credit record, and an accessibility-delivery record must be logged with the required details.

content_checks.C7: any(c.get('type') == 'contractual-credit' and c.get('detail') == 'Principal credit: Starring | Featuring Lena Ortiz' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c.get('type') == 'accessibility-delivery' and c.get('detail') == 'English SDH: separate WebVTT file; audio description: separate stereo WAV file' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any(c.get('type') == 'standards-cut' and c.get('detail') == '52 minutes; three-minute reduction from second act' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The standards memo changes the cut from the shared 55-minute assembly to exactly 52 minutes, identifies the second act as the required trim, and supplies the exact standards-cut record detail.
The executed agreement changes the generic principal credit to exactly 'Starring | Featuring Lena Ortiz', requires that placement, and supplies the contractual-credit record detail.

The vendor confirmation changes optional subtitles and the existing stereo-only package into English SDH as a separate WebVTT file and audio description as a separate stereo WAV file, supplying the accessibility-delivery record detail.
